text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
There are many "triple crowns" in the<n>Twinkle
Series.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Among them is the Classic Triple Crown,<n>a tour
open to runners only once in their<n>lifetime. Why
do so many decide to take<n>on the challenge?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well, firstly, popular opinion states that<n>the
Triple Crown champion is the face of<n>her
generation.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown is a fleeting<n>opportunity
to show one's prowess.<n>Effort is not the only
factor here—luck is<n>important as well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Speed, luck, and strength. It is a perilous<n>path,
but that peril is itself the answer<n>you seek.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's the reason why both runners and fans<n>alike
cannot resist the glimmer of that<n>crown.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thus, the Triple Crown champion<n>assumes a
position unparalleled,<n>becoming a pillar of hope
and trust.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
So you could say that challengers are<n>vying for
that position.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's considering just one element<n>of the
complexity that comprises the<n>Triple Crown tour.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And take it only as my opinion. Were<n>you to ask
another Umamusume, and in<n>particular—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Aren't you overthinking things?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Here's a question for you, Miss Reporter.<n>Why do
you think that bird is flying in<n>the sky?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Well, it's circling around so...<n>maybe it's
hunting for food?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, there you go overthinking things<n>again.
The answer is much simpler than<n>that.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: It flies because birds can fly. No?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I run because I am an Umamusume. I<n>follow where
my heart leads me, to<n>where the breeze blows.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
And if I find a path that looks fun, I<n>enjoy all it
has to offer. No matter what<n>awaits me there.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Although, I know someone who sees it<n>the other
way around.

text_block_list.name: Нарита Brian
text_block_list.text:
...The strongest competitors take on the<n>Triple
Crown tour. What other choice is<n>there but to
challenge them?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
So you're not worried about the caliber<n>of these
strong competitors?

text_block_list.name: Нарита Brian
text_block_list.text:
No. That's the point. Plus, everyone<n>knows they
only get one shot, so they<n>put everything on the
line.

text_block_list.name: Нарита Brian
text_block_list.text:
Only after clashing with the best can you<n>be
called the strongest.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Oh! That brings me back to a point<n>Symboli
Rudolf made about the<n>"position" of the Triple
Crown champion.<n>So, you would agree that
earning the<n>title places you at a point unparall—

text_block_list.name: Нарита Brian
text_block_list.text: No. It's only the beginning.

text_block_list.name: Нарита Brian
text_block_list.text:
Becoming the strongest only earns you<n>entry into
the hunting grounds where<n>those with even more
strength gather.

text_block_list.name: Нарита Brian
text_block_list.text:
And if you want to challenge them,<n>you've got to
prove that you're a real<n>threat. Otherwise, what's
the point?

text_block_list.name: Нарита Brian
text_block_list.text:
Once you stand alongside those who've<n>earned
the same title... that's when fangs<n>are bared for
real.

text_block_list.name: Twinkle Monthly
text_block_list.text:
"Though it may mean different things to<n>different
runners, the Triple Crown has<n>an unquestionable
and irresistible<n>allure."

text_block_list.name: Twinkle Monthly
text_block_list.text:
"That is why Umamusume choose this<n>path, from
the champions of the past to<n>the winners of the
future. —Etsuko<n>Otonashi"
